bug_locations: while q[user] and q[user][0] < t-window: (boundary condition in expiry check)
q[user].append(t) (appending rejected events to the queue)
explanation: Two bugs: (1) The window boundary was wrong: the spec defines the interval as (time-window, time], meaning strictly greater than time-window. The original code removed timestamps < t-window (keeping >= t-window), but should remove timestamps <= t-window (keeping > t-window). Fixed by changing `< t-window` to `<= t-window`. (2) The original code appended the timestamp to the queue unconditionally, but the spec says rejected events do not consume capacity. Fixed by only appending `t` when `ok` is True.
